items.question: In the UAE, how long after publication in the official Gazette does a federal law come into force, unless the law specifies another date?
items.gold: One month after publication in the official Gazette, unless the law specifies another date.
items.fact: Federal laws take effect one month after Gazette publication

items.question: What options does the Federal National Council have when reviewing a draft federal law (bill) prepared by the UAE Cabinet?
items.gold: It may pass, amend or reject the bill.
items.fact: FNC may pass, amend, or reject Cabinet bills
